claim: medicham2 spends `stall`'s duration:2 clock when the residual OPENS. Showdown spends it inside fieldEvent('Residual'), and the `stall` volatile carries NO onResidualOrder, so comparePriority's `order || 4294967296` (sim/battle.ts:405) sorts it AFTER every ordered handler. A residual that ends the battle at order 10 (a burn/poison chip) therefore returns before the decrement and leaves the counter standing; this engine had already spent it.
fix: move the _stallExpire() call from the residual OPEN to the FOOT of the residual group walk, guarded by the same sideWiped/faintQueueOwed predicate the group-top break reads. MEDI_STALL_LAPSE_AT_RESIDUAL_OPEN=1 restores today's placement.
